content.user_title: Create and Edit AI Music with RunComfy
content.value_statement: Choosing a music model and formatting its inputs can slow production. This skill routes requests and prepares RunComfy CLI commands for generation, inpainting, and extension.
actual_capabilities: Routes generation requests between ElevenLabs Music, ACE Step, and ACE Step 1.5.
Prepares RunComfy CLI inputs for instrumental tracks, vocal songs, jingles, and loops.
Structures style prompts, tags, lyrics, section markers, durations, and output locations.
Configures time-bounded audio inpainting to replace a selected track section.
Configures audio outpainting to add an intro, an outro, or both.
Explains model tradeoffs involving quality, language support, duration, and stated usage cost.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI, a RunComfy account, authentication, and network access.
Generation uses external paid services and sends request content outside the local environment.
The skill does not verify lyric ownership, music licensing, or commercial-use rights.
Output quality, supported languages, duration limits, and prices depend on the selected provider.

use_cases.title: Produce Campaign Music
use_cases.description: Create a polished jingle or vocal track with a defined mood, structure, length, and budget.

use_cases.title: Build Game Audio
use_cases.description: Generate affordable instrumental loops and background tracks with consistent style tags.

use_cases.title: Repair or Extend Audio
use_cases.description: Replace a timed section or expand an existing hook with a new intro and outro.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Instrumental
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 60-second instrumental track for a calm product tutorial. Use soft piano, light percussion, and no vocals.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Vocal Song
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate a 90-second indie-pop song with female vocals and 120 BPM. Include verse, chorus, bridge, and outro sections using my supplied lyrics.

prompt_templates.title: Repair a Track Section
prompt_templates.prompt: Replace seconds 20 through 40 of my audio URL. Match the original indie-pop style, remove drums, and use a soft piano breakdown.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Multilingual Release
prompt_templates.prompt: Create eight language versions with consistent arrangement and instrumentation. Compare ACE Step 1.5 and ElevenLabs, estimate costs, then prepare the preferred requests.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced model routing and batch planning

output_examples.input: Create an affordable 60-second instrumental loop for a puzzle game.
output_examples.output: Selected ACE Step base for low-cost iteration. Prepared tags for a seamless ambient loop, a 60-second duration, and instrumental output.

output_examples.input: Extend my 30-second hook with a 20-second intro and a 40-second outro.
output_examples.output: Selected ACE Step audio outpainting. Prepared the source-audio reference, both extension durations, matching style tags, and the output destination.

output_examples.input: Create a polished 15-second brand jingle with a short vocal slogan.
output_examples.output: Selected ElevenLabs Music for premium vocal quality. Prepared a concise style brief, section timing, slogan lyrics, and a 15-second target.

best_practices: State the intended use, duration, vocal needs, language, style, and budget before selecting a model.
Use short drafts to refine style and lyrics before requesting a longer premium render.
Confirm content rights and review estimated charges before sending a generation request.
anti_patterns: Do not include API tokens, private credentials, or confidential notes in prompts or lyrics.
Do not use copyrighted lyrics unless you have permission to process and reproduce them.
Do not repeatedly generate long premium tracks before validating the direction with a short draft.

faq.question: Which music models can this skill use?
faq.answer: It covers ElevenLabs Music, ACE Step base, ACE Step 1.5, ACE Step audio inpainting, and ACE Step audio outpainting.

faq.question: Can it generate instrumental music?
faq.answer: Yes. It can prepare instrumental requests for background music, jingles, game loops, and soundtracks.

faq.question: Can it edit an existing song?
faq.answer: Yes. ACE Step inpainting replaces a timed section, while outpainting extends audio before or after the source track.

faq.question: Does it support multilingual vocals?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill recommends ACE Step 1.5 or ElevenLabs Music when multilingual vocals are required.

faq.question: Does this skill run locally?
faq.answer: No. The CLI sends requests to RunComfy models and downloads generated audio to the selected output directory.

faq.question: Are generated tracks automatically cleared for commercial use?
faq.answer: No. Review provider terms and confirm rights for supplied lyrics, source audio, brands, and other protected material.
